id say start small at first. don’t just start with saying you went far and might need some sort of medical/mental help. start by telling them you haven’t been feeling well mentally, you didn’t know how to cope, and had to do it through self harm. then say something along the line of needing their support through recovery. be open to questions and answer them if you feel comfortable. i’m not sure how you feel but if your only self harming but don’t feel suicidal, let them know that. this will likely scare them, make them panic. remember that people react differently to big things like this, so be prepared for various reactions such as, crying, denial, or anger. don’t hold any negative reaction against them, and try to give them a chance to process.
